verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test mode is a fair question for an autonomous agent that acts on users' real email, calendar, payments and accounts, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no sandbox, test environment, or dry-run mode; the agent acts directly on connected production services. Community workarounds such as creating a separate Google account or limiting which credentials go into the Vault are user-side arrangements and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
